data.name: Fawhaat
data.gender_notes: Fawhaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is delicate, gentle, and fragile, often used for flowers and the beauty of nature. The name Fawhaat carries the meaning “Delicate, Fragile” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fawhaat usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, fragile and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Fawhaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Fragile.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fawhaat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
